summary: Deliver fault episodes to no-launch agents on their declared host

replay.detail: Existing claims and message idempotency keys remain authoritative; no claims are rewritten.

schema.detail: Uses the existing canonical KDL host child and existing message.sent contract; no fields, kinds or client contracts are added.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Top-level agent roots may omit both a primary launch and named tasks, remaining durable identities and fault recipients without runtime membership. Run-owned agents still require a launch. Inert agent cards do not reuse historical runtime or session observations after a launched-to-inert transition. Publication of memberless roots materializes the resolved host child, including inherited, default and local placement. Launched roots retain their existing canonical bytes and revisions; their resolved MemberSpec placement remains readable. Fault delivery selects declared placement rather than requiring a launch member.

manual.detail: Reapply older no-launch declarations without an explicit host to record their resolved placement; historical omitted placement cannot be reconstructed from a launch member.

recovery.detail: Rollback retains all durable episodes and mail; delivery to no-launch agents resumes after upgrading again.
